{{Quote|The Mon Gazza Spice Mines. Second only to Kessel in spice production.|A podrace announcer|<ref name="SWE1R" />}}
The '''Mon Gazza Spice Mines''' were a [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]]. In terms of productivity, that facility was only bested by the famous [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]],<ref name="SWE1R" /> where the [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathy]]-inducing [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] spice was collected.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> A settlement known as [[Miner's Town]] had been built around the mines to support the facility's work force. [[Groff Zugga]], guild boss of the Mon Gazza Spice Mines, was a noted [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] promoter.<ref name="SWE1R" />
